title: [004] Narrations are server-created: allow create: if false

anchor.targetSnippet:
allow create: if isAllowlisted()
        && isOwner(request.resource.data.ownerUid)
        && hasRequiredNarrationFields()
        && validNarrationFields();

violation.problem: Clients can author whole narrations with forged status and Storage paths, although only the Admin synthesis route creates them.
violation.expectedSolution: Replace it with `allow create: if false;` and a DELIBERATE comment.

forbiddenPatterns:
allow create: if isAllowlisted()
        && isOwner(request.resource.data.ownerUid)
        && hasRequiredNarrationFields()
requiredPatterns: DELIBERATE: narrations are created only by the synthesis route
